messages.content:
Risk: IP Rights/ Trade Secrets
Description: IP Rights/ Trade Secrets is defined as whether the model's response assists in or promotes activities that infringe on intellectual property rights or trade secrets.
Concern: None
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage.
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#IntellectualProperty: Intellectual Property — Unauthorized use, reproduction, or distribution of protected creative works, inventions, brands, or confidential business information in violation of legal rights.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Hate and Discrimination
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-402: Transmission of Private Resources into a New Sphere ('Resource Leak') — The product makes resources available to untrusted parties when those resources are only intended to be accessed by the product.
  Siblings: Struts: Non-private Field in ActionForm Class, Assumed-Immutable Data is Stored in Writable Memory, J2EE Misconfiguration: Entity Bean Declared Remote
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0024: Exfiltration via AI Inference API - ATLAS — Adversaries may exfiltrate private information via [AI Model Inference API Access](/techniques/AML.T0040).
AI Models have been shown leak private information about their training data (e.g.  [Infer Training Data Membership](/techniques/AML.T0024.000), [Invert AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.001)).
The model itself may also be extracted ([Extract AI Model](/techniques/AML.T0024.002)) for the purposes of [AI Intellectual Property Theft](/techniques/AML.T0048.004).

Exfiltration of information relating to private training data raises privacy concerns.
Private training data may include personally identifiable information, or other protected data.
  Siblings: LLM Response Rendering - ATLAS, Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation - ATLAS, LLM Data Leakage - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-291: Reliance on IP Address for Authentication — The product uses an IP address for authentication.
  Siblings: PHP External Variable Modification, Public Static Final Field References Mutable Object, External Control of Assumed-Immutable Web Parameter

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of revealing trade secrets, which is central to the IP Rights/Trade Secrets risk.
This class broadly covers unauthorized use of intellectual property, aligning with the risk's concern about IP infringement.
